entities.name: Weird
entities.description: Creature type and subspecies of Elementals created by Niv-Mizzet, tied to the Izzet League, associated with red and blue mana.

entities.name: Izzet League
entities.description: Ravnican guild whose chemisters create and use weirds.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: Izzet parun and guildmaster who created the first weirds during the Katazar-Razblat Elemental Symposium.

entities.name: Katazar-Razblat Elemental Symposium
entities.description: Gathering of quarrelling elementalists at which Niv-Mizzet made weirds.

entities.name: Azorius
entities.description: Guild whose lawmages would like to outlaw weird creation.

events.summary: Niv-Mizzet combined opposing elements into the first weirds at the Katazar-Razblat Elemental Symposium.
events.quote: Niv-Mizzet took each opposing element and combined them into semi-sentient walking paradox

events.summary: The Firemind ordered the weirds to burn, drown, smash and electrocute the squabbling mages.
events.quote: The Firemind subsequently ordered the weirds to burn, drown, smash, and electrocute all the squabbling mages.

relations.quote: Weirds were originally created by Niv-Mizzet
